description: Original Practice lines written for EyesRhythm. Not third-party quotations.

quotes.text: Soft lids, steady work.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: A full blink is a small reset.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Look, close, look again.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: The film on the eye likes a regular wipe.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Attention can wait one blink.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Let the lids meet, then return to the line.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Quiet eyes last longer at a desk.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Do not rush the close.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: One complete blink is worth two half ones.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: The screen can wait a tenth of a second.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Breathe, blink, continue.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Even gaps are kinder than clumps.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Keep the face still; let the lids move.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: A dry hour starts as a skipped blink.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Finish the blink you started.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Soft jaw, soft lids.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: The work is long. The wipe is short.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Look at the words; remember the eyes.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: A rhythm you can keep is enough.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Close all the way, then open.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Pause the stare, not the work.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Meet the lids. Refresh the film.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Small, complete, often enough.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Hold the thought; blink through it.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: The hour is made of many short closes.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Do not save all the blinks for later.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: A shallow blink leaves a dry strip.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Return to the screen with wet eyes.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Slow the lids. They know the rest.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Count is not enough; finish the motion.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Between sentences, a close.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: The next line will still be there.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Ease the forehead. Then blink.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Regular is quieter than rushed.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Give the oil glands a full squeeze.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Stay with the work. Take the wipe.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Lids down, lids up, back to the keys.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: A still face can still blink well.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Let this minute have even gaps.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Nothing important is lost in a blink.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: The companion is quiet. The lids can be too.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: One more complete close, then go on.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Keep the rhythm you just found.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Dryness is a late messenger. Blink now.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: The cursor can wait for the lids.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: Soft light, full blink, next task.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: You do not have to stare to see.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm

quotes.text: End this minute kinder than it began.
quotes.author: EyesRhythm
